Electrical Engineering

New positions in Electrical Engineering
Join us and become a driver of change
The Department of Electrical Engineering at TU/e educates Bachelor and Master of Science students (BSc/MSc), PDEng (Professional Doctors in Engineering) and PhD students. In addition to this, we carry out cutting-edge research in many domains of Electrical Engineering. Much research is done in close cooperation with large high-tech companies, such as Philips, ASML, NXP, as well as many small/medium enterprises.
The department aims to maintain and extend its international forefront position, and strives for strong international cooperation. We offer a challenging and inspiring atmosphere, where we work together to solve socially relevant problems.
Are you ready to make an impact, work across disciplines, and shape the future of technology?
Join us and become a driver of change!
Check our vacancies

Brainport and Project Beethoven
The Netherlands is accelerating its semiconductor ecosystem through Beethoven, a national program to strengthen Brainport Eindhoven’s growth. TU/e is committed to educating 2,000 additional engineers by 2030, and is expanding master’s programs in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science, and Applied Physics and Science Education. As part of this ambition, Electrical Engineering is seeking for new ambitious talents to bridge breakthroughs from the lab to real-world applications.

Relocate to a vibrant city and innovative region
TU/e is a truly international university, with one-third of our academic staff coming from abroad. We understand that moving to a new country—with different habits, systems, and procedures—can be a big step. That’s why we do everything we can to make your transition to Eindhoven as smooth as possible, so you feel at home quickly and can focus on what matters most: your work and your life.
And there’s more than just a great professional environment. Eindhoven is part of a thriving region with a buzzing city center just minutes from campus, offering cultural, culinary, and entertainment options, plus an active international community. Families relocating here benefit from excellent and accessible childcare and education, and for partners, we provide support in finding dual career opportunities that match their skills and ambitions.

Working at TU/e
You’re passionate about building a better future for our global society through science. Surrounded by scientists and technological companies who share your goals, the lines between fundamental research and applied, hands-on research are blurred to such an extent that every chance encounter is an opportunity. You’re given the freedom and autonomy to live out your vision and to build a brighter tomorrow for us all. Find your challenge at TU/e.
